Usage: schedule [options] [command [args...]]

Cross-platform task scheduler with cron expressions.

Options:
  --all                        Show all tasks, not just Winix-managed
  --cron EXPR                  Cron expression (required for add)
  --name NAME                  Task name (auto-generated if omitted)
  --folder PATH                Task Scheduler folder (default: \Winix\ on Windows)
  --count N                    Number of occurrences to show (default: 5)
  -h, --help                   Show help
  --version                    Show version
  --no-color                   Disable colored output
  --json                       JSON output
  --describe                   Structured JSON metadata for AI agents
  --color[=auto|always|never]  Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never

Examples:
  schedule add --cron "0 2 * * *" -- dotnet build                                             Create a task that runs daily at 2am
  schedule add --cron "*/5 * * * *" --name health-check -- curl http://localhost:8080/health  Create a named task
  schedule list                                                                               List Winix-managed tasks
  schedule list --all                                                                         List all scheduled tasks
  schedule remove health-check                                                                Remove a task
  schedule enable health-check                                                                Enable a disabled task
  schedule disable health-check                                                               Disable a task
  schedule run health-check                                                                   Trigger immediate execution
  schedule history health-check                                                               Show run history
  schedule next "0 2 * * *"                                                                   Show next 5 fire times for a cron expression
  schedule next "*/5 * * * *"
